about.title: La Habra Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member in a traffic collision changes everything, and it's hard to think about legal deadlines when you're grieving. In 2025, Orange County recorded three traffic deaths tied to La Habra, on corridors like Whittier Boulevard and Lambert Road that carry heavy weekday traffic, especially around Friday evenings. California law gives surviving spouses, domestic partners, and children priority standing to bring a wrongful death claim, with other dependents and heirs potentially eligible depending on the family situation. These civil claims are separate from any criminal case tied to the crash, and they can address funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of a loved one's companionship and guidance. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm, that connects grieving families in La Habra with an independent personal injury attorney who can walk through options at no upfront cost.

items.title: Standing Rules Can Be Complicated
items.desc: California limits who can file a wrongful death claim, starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, then extending to other dependents in some cases. An independent attorney can help sort out who qualifies before time runs short.

items.title: The Clock Starts Ticking Fast
items.desc: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim, though claims against a government entity carry a much shorter window. Getting matched with an attorney early helps protect your family's ability to pursue a claim.

items.title: Losses Go Beyond the Obvious
items.desc: Wrongful death claims in California can account for funeral and burial expenses, lost financial support, and the loss of a loved one's love, companionship, and guidance. An attorney can help make sure these losses are properly documented and presented.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Priority generally goes to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children. If none of those exist, other dependents or heirs may have standing depending on the circumstances. An independent attorney can review your family's situation and explain where you stand.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as a criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No, they're separate. A criminal case is brought by the state and focuses on punishment, while a wrongful death claim is a civil case brought by the family seeking compensation for their losses. One can proceed regardless of the outcome of the other.

items.question: Are certain roads in La Habra more likely to see fatal crashes?
items.answer: Public collision records show corridors like La Habra Boulevard, Imperial Highway, Whittier Boulevard, and Lambert Road carry high traffic volumes, with crashes tending to cluster on Friday afternoons and early evenings. These are simply reported counts, not a judgment about any particular road.
